title: GET /api/ibkr/status -- surface IBKR gateway connection state
description: app.api.dependencies.get_ibkr_provider exists and is already a thread-safe singleton (backend-ibkr-data-provider-followups), but nothing calls it -- the provider is fully dormant end-to-end. Add a read-only status endpoint wrapping IBKRProvider.get_gateway_status() so the app can actually surface 'IBKR: connected / not authenticated / gateway down / disabled' instead of this being invisible everywhere.

checklist.step: Add GET /api/ibkr/status returning the gateway state (available/gateway_unreachable/not_authenticated) plus an explicit 'disabled' state when Settings.ibkr_enabled is False, and a detail string.
Ensure the endpoint never raises for any gateway state -- degrade to the appropriate status value instead, matching IBKRProvider.get_gateway_status's own never-raises contract.
Unit tests mocking IBKRProvider for each of the four states (disabled, available, gateway_unreachable, not_authenticated).
